title: Content Strategist
jobDescription: Job Overview: We are looking to hire a driven content strategist to develop and execute content strategies that drive traffic and generate leads. The content strategist’s responsibilities include determining which formats best communicate various types of content, identifying ways to increase brand awareness, and conducting keyword research. You should also be able to analyse user engagement metrics to determine whether the content is well-received or not. Roles and Responsibilities Cultivate content marketing strategies targeted at driving traffic and engagement, generating leads, delivering sales, retaining customers, building brand awareness and hitting other key content metrics. Develop a brand voice to ensure consistency across all content assets. Work with internal and external collaborators and creative resources to deliver content assets that are coherent with our brand voice and strategy. Track and advance the editorial calendar, and regularly measure and distil progress results to apply data-driven insights to future content strategies. Apply SEO, content development, distribution, and measurement to effectively tailor content to reach audience personas. Manage digital and social content channels including email or newsletter distribution, with an understanding of the best content practices on each channel. Assist with integrating content strategy deliverables and time-specific brand campaigns to drive campaign goals. Mobilize storytelling opportunities or optimize existing content on all channels — owned, earned, and paid platforms. Establish strategies for media relations, seeking placements in print, broadcast, and online channels, and create the corresponding content including press releases, articles, and presentations. Build relationships with thought leaders and nurture brand awareness, while gathering knowledge of industry trends. Test and implement innovative and relevant methods of measuring content, campaigns, and tools, keeping in mind the purpose of the derived results. Content Strategist Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, advertising, journalism, or related field. Proven content strategy and project management experience. Sound knowledge of content management systems, keyword research tools, social media platforms, search engine optimization (SEO), and search engine marketing (SEM). The ability to work under pressure. Strong content presentation skills. Outstanding organizational and time management skills. Excellent analytical skills. Exceptional marketing and collaborative skills. Effective communication skills.

Comprehension of and familiarity with social media. Good time management and organizational expert.

title: Database Administrator
jobDescription: Job Overview: We are seeking a skilled Database Administrator with a strong background in MySQL queries, Excel automation, and data analysis. This role will focus on supporting data reporting processes, ensuring data quality, and creating actionable insights through dashboards, graphs, and visualizations. If you’re passionate about data-driven decision-making and adopting new technologies to enhance processes, we’d love to have you join our team! Key Responsibilities: Data Management & Analysis: Strong knowledge of MySQL queries for data extraction, processing, and analysis. Excel Automation: Automate Excel workflows and apply advanced Excel formulas to streamline data manipulation and reporting processes. ETL Tool Experience: Utilize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) tools for data integration and processing. Data Quality Assurance: Monitor and audit data quality to ensure consistency, accuracy, and completeness across all datasets. Reporting Processes: Develop and support reporting systems, including automated reports and ad-hoc requests, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of insights. Data Visualizations: Create clear, actionable data dashboards, graphs, and visualizations to communicate insights effectively to stakeholders. Data Processing: Filter, process, collate, and allocate data through Excel to produce meaningful outputs and insights. Adopt New Technologies: Stay up to date with emerging technologies and tools to improve data analysis processes and drive innovation. Qualifications: Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in data analysis, data processing, and reporting. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in MySQL queries for data extraction and analysis. Advanced knowledge of Excel, including automation, formulae, and data manipulation. Experience working with ETL tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica, SSIS) for data integration. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends, and provide actionable insights. Reporting & Visualization: Experience in developing reports and creating dashboards using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Excel. Attention to Detail: High level of attention to detail and a passion for ensuring data accuracy. Technology Adoption: A proactive approach to learning and adopting new technologies to improve data processes. Why Join Us? Impactful Work: Play a key role in transforming data into actionable insights that drive decision-making. Growth Opportunities: Develop your skills and advance your career in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a talented team of professionals committed to innovation and excellence.

title: Sr. Big Data Engineer
jobDescription: Job Overview We are looking to hire a talented big data engineer to develop and manage our company’s Big Data solutions. In this role, you will be required to design and implement Big Data tools and frameworks, implement ELT processes, collaborate with development teams, build cloud platforms, and maintain the production system. To ensure success as a big data engineer, you should have in-depth knowledge of Hadoop technologies, excellent project management skills, and high-level problem-solving skills. A top-notch Big Data Engineer understands the needs of the company and institutes scalable data solutions for its current and future needs. Big Data Engineer Responsibilities Meeting with managers to determine the company’s Big Data needs. Developing big data solutions on AWS, using Apache Spark, Databricks, Delta Tables, EMR, Athena, Glue, Hadoop, etc. Loading disparate data sets and conducting pre-processing services using Athena, Glue, Spark, etc. Collaborating with the software research and development teams. Building cloud platforms for the development of company applications. Maintaining production systems. Big Data Engineer Requirements: 5+ years of experience as a big data engineer. Must be proficient with Python & PySpark. In-depth knowledge of Hadoop, Apache Spark, Databricks, Delta Tables, AWS data analytics services. Must have extensive experience with Delta Tables, JSON, Parquet file format. Must have experience with AWS data analytics services like Athena, Glue, Redshift, EMR. Familiarity with Data warehousing will be a plus. Must have Knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS databases. Good communication skills. Ability to solve complex data processing, transformation related problems.

title: Voice and Accent Trainer
jobDescription: Position Overview: The Voice and Accent Trainer will be responsible for coaching and developing the communication skills of our agents, ensuring they sound calm, composed, and natural on calls. The trainer will work closely with the operations and quality teams to identify training needs, design customized training programs, and provide ongoing support to agents, focusing on improving voice, accent, and overall communication effectiveness. Key Responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive voice and accent training sessions for agents involved in outbound cold calling. Develop customized training modules to improve pronunciation, intonation, stress patterns, and overall fluency. Provide coaching on communication skills, including active listening, speech clarity, tone modulation, and maintaining composure during calls. Monitor and assess agents’ performance on calls, providing constructive feedback and actionable insights for improvement. Design and implement evaluation processes to track progress and measure the effectiveness of training programs. Collaborate with the operations and quality teams to identify areas of improvement and develop targeted training plans. Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in voice and accent training and incorporate them into training programs. Conduct refresher training sessions to ensure continuous improvement and skill retention. Assist in the development of communication standards and guidelines for the team. Qualifications: A minimum of 3+ years of experience as a Voice and Accent Trainer, preferably in the BPO, lead generation, or call centre industry. Strong understanding of voice modulation, phonetics, and accent neutralization techniques. Excellent communication skills with a clear, articulate speaking voice. Ability to coach and mentor individuals at various skill levels, from beginners to advanced. Familiarity with the challenges of outbound cold calling and strategies to overcome them. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with agents and team members. Certification in Voice and Accent Training or related fields is a plus.
